CompleteQuestA3S4: ^Narrator: Chione skillfully builds a split to support the calf’s leg. Since it’s a light injury, it’s able to get up and walk without much pain.
^Narrator: As the Calf moves to leave the room however, you notice some odd etchings in the stone wall, close to the ground.
^Calf: Huh? Oh, no — those were there when I got here. Looked like claw marks to me.
^Chione: Hm… Like from another creature who was stuck before?
^Amelia: I dunno… even mountain dragons like me would need some force to do that.
^Narrator: You kneel down to inspect it closer, running your fingers over the carved-in stone.
^Noelle: These are wayfinding shorthands. For when the weather makes it too hard to see, and we have to figure out the direction on our gears…
^Noelle: (But why would they be on the walls of a ruin?)
^Chione: None of us would’ve recognised it for that…
^Noelle: They’re meant to be read from touch, after all.
^Amelia: If it’s a language from your homeland…
^Narrator: The group trails off, leading to the same conclusion — were these from Noah’s time?
^Noelle: (And… was Noah really from Dusk, after all?)
